grants.comment: agent broker: open Arc cluster-connect tunnels to the shared homelab k3s cluster on dockhost. Re-pointed 2026-08-05: the cluster was re-registered from rg-claude-runner-preview (claude-k8s-preview, a parked 2026-06-23 spike that quietly became load-bearing) to its correct home rg-homelab (dockhost-k3s) alongside the dockhost Arc machine, now that claude-runner is retired and no longer needs the shared registration. Re-registering minted a NEW OIDC issuer, so this grant's scope and every k8s federated credential moved together in one change.
roles: Azure Arc Enabled Kubernetes Cluster User Role

grants.comment: agent sessions (coder profile): read-only estate visibility (resource state + runtime logs), matching the claude-runner and claude-coder coder profiles. Same identity on both backends (IMDS on ACI, workload-identity federation on the homelab cluster).

agent coder profile: cost visibility, folded in when the cloud-sysadmin profile was retired (2026-07-25). Read-only — 'what is the estate costing' without a second profile. Every Azure CHANGE still goes through Bicep + Actions.

agent local-sysadmin profile: full read-only estate visibility — resource state, runtime logs and cost. Kenneth's ask 2026-08-04: the local-sysadmin profile absorbs the retired cloud-sysadmin role and becomes sysadmin for cloud AND local, so it gets the same read set the coder profile holds (the two grants above). Read-only — every Azure CHANGE still goes through Bicep + Actions. The matching Entra directory read is in graph-grants.json.

inference-lab CI/deploy SP (sp-inference-lab-github): push + post-deploy cleanup-delete on the shared ACR (acrkscloud, see acr/main.bicep), ABAC-conditioned to this repo's own 'inference-lab/' path only — it cannot read, write, or delete any other repo's images. First repo migrated to the shared registry (2026-08-06), proving the shared-ACR + Entra ABAC isolation pattern before rolling out to the rest. Contributor, not Writer: container-app-deploy-app.yml's cleanup job deletes stale manifests, and Writer has no delete DataAction.
grants.condition: ( ( !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/content/read'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/metadata/read'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/content/write'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/metadata/write'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/content/delete'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/metadata/delete'}) ) OR ( @Request[Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories:name] StringStartsWithIgnoreCase 'inference-lab/' ) )

grants.comment:
inference-lab CI/deploy SP: two CONTROL-PLANE roles the ABAC data-plane grant above cannot cover — discovered empirically 2026-08-06 when container-app-deploy-app.yml's prime-base-images job failed `az acr import -n acrkscloud` with '...could not be found in subscription' (the ABAC data-plane roles grant ZERO Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/read, so the registry can't even be resolved by name). Neither role below supports Entra ABAC conditions (confirmed against the ACR built-in roles directory reference) — registry-wide is this permission model's own floor, not a design choice here:
        - Container Registry Data Importer and Data Reader: control-plane trigger for `az acr import` (prime-base-images caching Docker Hub base images into the shared registry) + registry-wide PULL-only data access to verify the import succeeded. No push/write/delete anywhere in the registry.
        - Container Registry Tasks Contributor: control-plane permission to trigger `az acr build` quick builds. The actual data-plane push (to inference-lab/app) stays gated by the ABAC-conditioned Contributor grant above — this only lets the SP schedule the build.
      Every other repo migrated to the shared registry will need this identical unconditioned pair alongside its own ABAC-conditioned data-plane grant.
roles: Container Registry Data Importer and Data Reader

grants.comment: inference-lab runtime pull identity (id-inference-lab, rg-inference-lab): read-only pull from the shared ACR, ABAC-conditioned to this repo's own 'inference-lab/' path only. Companion to the CI grant above — same '/' prefix boundary, same 2026-08-06 first-repo migration.

cvr-portal CI/deploy SP (sp-cvr-portal-github): push + cleanup-delete on the shared ACR, ABAC-conditioned to this repo's own 'cvr-portal/' path only. Second repo migrated to the shared registry (2026-08-06), same pattern proven on inference-lab. Contributor, not Writer — cleanup needs delete.
grants.condition: ( ( !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/content/read'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/metadata/read'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/content/write'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/metadata/write'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/content/delete'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/metadata/delete'}) ) OR ( @Request[Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories:name] StringStartsWithIgnoreCase 'cvr-portal/' ) )

grants.comment: cvr-portal CI/deploy SP: the two unconditioned control-plane roles every shared-ACR repo needs alongside its ABAC data-plane grant — see Azure-infrastructure/CLAUDE.md 'Azure Container Registry — migrating per-repo to shared' for why (registry name resolution for `az acr import`, and triggering `az acr build` — neither is expressible as an ABAC condition, confirmed against the ACR built-in roles directory reference). Same pair as inference-lab's.
roles: Container Registry Data Importer and Data Reader

grants.comment: cvr-portal runtime pull identity (id-cvr-portal, rg-cvr-portal): read-only pull from the shared ACR, ABAC-conditioned to this repo's own 'cvr-portal/' path only.

agent CI/deploy SP, PROD (sp-agent-github): push + cleanup-delete on the shared ACR, ABAC-conditioned to 'agent/' only. Third repo migrated (2026-08-06) and the first with a live preview environment — preview uses its OWN distinct prefix 'agent-preview/' (see the preview grants below and container-app-deploy-app.yml's IMAGE_REPO logic), so this condition genuinely cannot reach anything preview pushes: 'agent-preview/...' does not start with 'agent/' (differs at the 6th character).
grants.condition: ( ( !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/content/read'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/metadata/read'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/content/write'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/metadata/write'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/content/delete'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/metadata/delete'}) ) OR ( @Request[Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories:name] StringStartsWithIgnoreCase 'agent/' ) )

grants.comment: agent CI/deploy SP, PROD: the unconditioned control-plane pair every shared-ACR repo needs — see Azure-infrastructure/CLAUDE.md. Same as inference-lab/cvr-portal.
roles: Container Registry Data Importer and Data Reader

grants.comment: agent runtime pull identity, PROD (id-agent, rg-agent): read-only pull from the shared ACR, ABAC-conditioned to 'agent/' only.

agent CI/deploy SP, PREVIEW (sp-agent-preview-github): push + cleanup-delete on the shared ACR, ABAC-conditioned to 'agent-preview/' only — a DIFFERENT top-level prefix from prod's 'agent/', not a sub-path of it, so this identity (Owner of rg-agent-preview only, per the estate's preview-isolation design — 'it can never touch prod') genuinely cannot write anywhere under 'agent/'.
grants.condition: ( ( !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/content/read'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/metadata/read'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/content/write'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/metadata/write'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/content/delete'}) AND !(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories/metadata/delete'}) ) OR ( @Request[Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries/repositories:name] StringStartsWithIgnoreCase 'agent-preview/' ) )

grants.comment: agent CI/deploy SP, PREVIEW: the unconditioned control-plane pair (see PROD entry above for why). Registry-wide by the ACR permission model's own design, same as every other repo's pair — this does not let preview touch prod's repository content, only trigger imports/builds, which the ABAC condition above still gates by path.
roles: Container Registry Data Importer and Data Reader
